dct_title_s: Satellite detected waters extents, as of 18 January 2020 over Konarak District in Sistan Va Baluchestan Province of Iran
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20200117IRN** This map illustrates satellite-detected water surface in Konarak District in Sistan Va Baluchestan Province of Iran as observed from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 18 January 2020. Within the analysed extent of about 590 km2, a total about 55 km2 of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
